rv.q: The energetic eight-strong chorus sing, dance and skip their way through the story, pulling on different outfits like kids playing dress-up, only to puncture the silliness with reminders of their deadly fate.

She has a wry wit and a deep-rooted antipathy to good-time girl Helen. Apart from Bullmore, the cast is made up of eight young female actors playing her maids and also every other part going. One of the problems for Juliet Forster is the question of tone.
